description: This file contains the implementation of a builder class for creating responses and events related to modifying attributes in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It specifically handles building success responses, error responses, and event objects indicating attribute creation or modification.

classes.name: ModifyAttributesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
classes.description: A final class that extends an abstract answer builder to create various responses and events for the ModifyAttributesLiveCommand, with internal factory classes for response and event creation.

classes.name: ResponseFactoryImpl
classes.description: Immutable internal class implementing ResponseFactory interface; creates different types of command responses and error responses based on the command context.

classes.name: EventFactoryImpl
classes.description: Immutable internal class implementing EventFactory interface; creates event objects indicating attribute creation or modification with current timestamp.

methods.name: doCreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a command response by applying a provided function to a ResponseFactory instance.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates an event object by applying a provided function to an EventFactory instance.
